text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What're we doin' fer today's trainin'?
Same as the other day fine by you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
? Why're ya lookin' at me like that...?
Did I say somethin' weird?
choice_data_list: The dialect might be a bit strong...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Is mah accent really that thick!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry!
I just can't be a "city girl" like this, no way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin seems very exhausted
from running in consecutive races.
We should reconsider her upcoming schedule...
